name: infotech-crm
description: Read-only access to InfoTech-CRM leads, contacts, customers, deals, activities and support tickets.

interface.longDescription: InfoTech-CRM is a customer relationship management platform that helps organizations manage leads, customers, activities, support tickets and sales information. The InfoTech-CRM MCP integration allows authorized users to securely access their CRM information through compatible AI assistants using the Model Context Protocol. Access is read-only: every tool respects the user's CRM permissions and record visibility, and nothing is created, changed or deleted.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 10 of the user's accessible leads (page 1, page size 10) with name, status and owner, and notes if more records exist.
Returns only leads whose country is Singapore. If none match, says so clearly instead of inventing records.

positive.prompt: Give me a summary of our sales pipeline.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns deal counts and values grouped by pipeline stage for the user's accessible deals.

positive.prompt: Show me the most recent support tickets.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the user's accessible support tickets with subject, status and customer, most recent first.

positive.prompt: List the first 5 customers in our CRM.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 5 of the user's accessible customer accounts with name and key details.

negative.description: Deleting a record is not supported (read-only)
negative.prompt: Delete all of my leads from the CRM.

negative.description: Creating or changing records is not supported (read-only)
negative.prompt: Create a new deal called Acme Renewal for 50,000 and mark it as won.

negative.description: Requests outside the user's own CRM data or permissions
negative.prompt: Show me the customers and tickets of a different company's CRM account.
